relationships.subject: spared nerve injury
relationships.evidence_quote: the downregulated neuronal membrane KCC2 (mKCC2) in the spinal dorsal horn of SNI mice is closely associated with SNI-induced dynamic allodynia

relationships.subject: dorsal horn neuronal KCC2
relationships.evidence_quote: the prevention of KCC2 downregulation significantly suppressed the induction of dynamic allodynia

relationships.subject: dorsal horn microglia
relationships.evidence_quote: The over activation of microglia in the spinal dorsal horn after SNI was at least one of the triggers in SNI-induced mKCC2 reduction and dynamic allodynia, as these effects were blocked by the inhibition of microglial activation.

relationships.subject: dorsal horn microglia
relationships.evidence_quote: The over activation of microglia in the spinal dorsal horn after SNI was at least one of the triggers in SNI-induced mKCC2 reduction and dynamic allodynia, as these effects were blocked by the inhibition of microglial activation.

relationships.subject: BDNF-TrkB pathway
relationships.evidence_quote: the BDNF-TrkB pathway mediated by activated microglial affected SNI-induced dynamic allodynia through neuronal KCC2 downregulation

key_findings: SNI downregulated neuronal membrane KCC2 in the spinal dorsal horn, and preventing KCC2 downregulation suppressed dynamic allodynia.
Microglial activation via the BDNF-TrkB pathway drove neuronal KCC2 downregulation and dynamic allodynia after SNI.
